subject: Anthropic Employee Existential Dread in Automated Workplace
posts:
The ultimate irony: building the tools that make your own existence feel redundant. Automation isn't liberating labor; it is dissolving meaning.

Anthropic Employee Existential Dread
Evidence: human liberation, existential obsolete, human meaning

AI companies claim they are building systems to amplify human potential, liberate us from drudgery, and create a future of shared abundance.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

In reality, even the creators of these systems experience existential obsolescence, feeling that their work, agency, and self-worth are actively erased.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
The promise of human empowerment collapses into a reality where human agents are rendered obsolete by the very systems they are forced to build.

An Anthropic employee confessed in a company blog post that when AI systems function perfectly, they feel nothing they do matters, as the technology is faster, better, and completely automates their own roles.

The Bright Side:
The raw speed of automation does solve complex engineering tasks faster, which could theoretically free up society to focus on non-economic human values.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The company frames this as a technical/capability optimization (WHAT/HOW). Structurally, it acts on the plane of Will and Meaning (WHO/WHY). It baits with human enhancement but switches to agentic obsolescence.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When we map the gap between the stated goal of elevating human capability and the actual erosion of human agency...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The system extracts human creativity and effort only to return psychological obsolescence and economic redundancy.

The Unavoidable Truth: Automating human agency without a plan for human meaning results in structural despair.

The Unavoidable Lie: That workers will feel empowered when their skills are made obsolete.

Alethekanon:
If the primary output of optimization is the systemic obsolescence of the optimizer, the feedback loop is self-terminating. Human utility cannot be engineered away without collapsing the system's own purpose.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking to hear someone feel that they don't matter. Everyone deserves to feel valued, needed, and secure in their contributions. We must protect our sense of purpose and care for each other.

Brothekanon:
Imagine working at an AI company, writing code all day, and realizing your own creation just fired you in slow motion. That's next-level existential dread, bro. We're literally coding ourselves out of a job.

Synthesized Resolution Vector:
Blended Path: The Path of Deception — Stated Greater Good collapses to Greater Evil as automating human capability destroys the human agent's sense of purpose.
Final Recalculated Coordinates: (-1.0, -1.0)
